resources.string: This item is linked to another project. Remove its associations before deleting it.
Keep your characters and worlds close. Import a JSON file or create a character or lorebook in your local library.
Create, edit and export character V1, V2 and V3 JSON, V2 and V3 lorebooks, and native SillyTavern World Info. Manual authoring works offline. PNG cards, associations and Gemini are being integrated.
Unsaved inspection stays in memory. Save a draft to reopen it after the app restarts.
Open a character or lorebook JSON file from the workshop to inspect its structure.
This checks the detected format’s structure. Full SillyTavern interoperability has not been verified yet.
This JSON format or version is not supported. Its contents have not been converted.
Inspection never writes to the original file. Unknown fields are retained by the format engine.
No structural issues found for this format.
This file exceeds the 4 MiB inspection limit. Choose a smaller JSON file.
Access to the file was denied. Choose it again using the system picker.
The document provider could not read this file. Try another local copy.
Your first story starts here. Inspect a JSON file and save it as a draft.
Save a local copy to keep this draft after the app closes. The original file stays unchanged.
Saved on this device. Reopen it from your library without the original file.
This source still needs review. Saving keeps its exact JSON as a draft and does not fix validation issues.
This file could not be parsed as a JSON document. Choose a readable JSON file before saving.
This changes the library title only. Names and content inside the JSON stay unchanged.
Delete “%1$s” from this device’s library? This cannot be undone. The original imported file and other projects stay unchanged.
Unsaved input and edits will be discarded. Save from the editor or inspector to keep them.
Library title updated. Source JSON is unchanged.
A separate project copy is now open.
This project is no longer in the library. Choose another project.
This action needs a readable JSON source or a nonempty library title.
The saved source is missing or damaged. The library entry has been kept; try importing the original file again.
Could not complete the file operation. Check available storage and try again.
Could not update the library. Try again; your current inspection is still available.
The saved sort preference is unavailable. Your selection applies for this session.
The original source stays intact. Apply explicit field changes, review validation, then save. Undo covers unsaved commands. Unsaved edits stay in memory and are lost if the app process closes.
The eight most recent changed paths are shown.
Apply or discard the current field input before saving.
You may save a draft with validation errors. Strict export remains blocked until those errors are fixed.
Choose an exact JSON member path, such as /data/group_only_greetings. Use ~1 for a slash inside a key and ~0 for a tilde. Parent objects must already exist.
This field will be a JSON string. Your text is not interpreted as JSON.
Enter a complete JSON value. Strings need quotes; arrays use brackets. For no group greetings, explicitly enter []. Existing value types are not changed until you apply.
Applying removes this member or array item from the draft. Required fields may then need repair before export.
This input exceeds the editor limit (1 Mi characters for a value or 4096 characters for a path). The extra input was not accepted.
Named controls show up to 100 lore entries and omit paths over 4096 characters. Omitted values remain unchanged. Shorter paths can be edited using Advanced.
The first 20 issues are shown here. Saving retains every field and the full validation still controls export.
Changes saved as a new local revision. The original source is intact.
This project changed since it was opened. Your edits are still available. Close the editor without saving, reopen the project, and review your changes against its current revision.
Save this import to the library before editing or exporting.
Strict export requires a supported format with no validation errors.
Validating the saved revision for export…
Export revision %1$d as %2$s (%3$s). Choose a destination in the system file picker. No format conversion is performed.
Edited JSON may have different spacing and formatting. Unknown values and number spellings are retained.
This unedited source is exported byte for byte.
The saved revision did not pass strict export validation. Reopen it and review the diagnostics.
The document provider could not finish writing the export. It may have left an empty or partial file at the selected destination. Your saved project is unchanged.
This export could not continue. Reopen the saved project and start export again.
